name: update_contact
description: Log in with the given username and password, open the Update Contact Info page, replace the phone number with the given phone number and the city with the given city, click Update Profile, and read the confirmation message into an output named confirmation

approved_plan.goal: Log in with the given username and password, open the Update Contact Info page, replace the phone number with the given phone number and the city with the given city, click Update Profile, and read the confirmation message into an output named confirmation

steps.intent: Log in with the supplied username and password and reach the Accounts Overview page
steps.action: Replay reusable fragment parabank_login@1.0.0 with username and password

steps.intent: Navigate to the Update Contact Info page
steps.action: Locate and click the 'Update Contact Info' link in the user navigation menu

steps.intent: Replace the phone number field with the supplied phone number
steps.action: Clear the existing phone number field and type the supplied phone_number value

steps.intent: Replace the city field with the supplied city
steps.action: Clear the existing city field and type the supplied city value

steps.intent: Read the confirmation message from the page into the output named confirmation
steps.action: Capture the confirmation message text displayed on the page after the update
